updates.summary: About Us || Faces Behind the Brilliance || Image gets excessively zoomed on hover
updates.steps:
1. Open https://sunnydiamonds-web-dev.on-forge.com/world-of-sunny on desktop (≥1280px).
2. Scroll to the Faces Behind the Brilliance section.
3. Hover over any team member card.
4. Measure card width vs image container width.
updates.expected: Subtle grow effect on hover; image is not excessively cropped and matches Figma (SD-1).
updates.actual: Desktop hover: card is ~477px wide but image container expands to ~719px — over-zoom/crop observed in automated browser test.

updates.summary: About Us || Since 1997 || First gallery description not mapped correctly
updates.steps:
1. Open /world-of-sunny.
2. Scroll to the Since 1997 gallery.
3. Inspect the first gallery block in CMS (image + description fields).
4. Compare rendered caption/description on the first image.
updates.expected: Each gallery image shows its own CMS caption/description (SD-2).
updates.actual: Code only renders caption when both image and caption exist; description field is ignored when an image is present — risk of missing copy on first block.

updates.summary: About Us || Since 1997 || 2nd and 3rd image descriptions not displayed from CMS
updates.steps:
1. Open /world-of-sunny.
2. Scroll to the Since 1997 gallery.
3. Review CMS descriptions for the 2nd and 3rd gallery blocks.
4. Compare with text rendered below/on each image.
updates.expected: Second and third gallery images each show their own CMS description (SD-3).
updates.actual: Mapper prefers caption over description when image exists; CMS description copy may not surface for blocks 2 and 3.

updates.summary: About Us || Handcrafted Brilliance || Text card titles mismatch / duplicate
updates.steps:
1. Open /world-of-sunny.
2. Scroll to Handcrafted Brilliance mosaic.
3. Inspect text-card tiles with CMS titles configured.
4. Compare titles against Figma and CMS values.
updates.expected: Each text-card tile displays the correct unique title from CMS/Figma (SD-4).
updates.actual: Titles render, but CMS currently has duplicate titles (e.g. Pinnacle… ×2, Highest Level… ×2) — Partial pass in latest test run.

updates.summary: About Us || Timeline defaults via years[0] instead of explicit 1997
updates.steps:
1. Open /world-of-sunny.
2. Scroll to the Timeline section.
3. Note the active year on load.
4. Inspect about-page.mapper defaultYear logic.
updates.expected: Timeline opens on first milestone year 1997 regardless of CMS array order (SD-5).
updates.actual: Live page currently shows 1997 with present CMS order, but code sets defaultYear = years[0] — fragile; breaks if CMS reorders milestones.

updates.summary: About Us || Hero section animation does not match Figma
updates.steps:
1. Open /world-of-sunny on desktop.
2. Load the hero and scroll slightly.
3. Compare hero title collapse/scroll animation with Figma motion spec.
updates.expected: Hero load/scroll animation matches Figma motion design (SD-6).
updates.actual: Hero titleStyle animation is commented out — scroll title animation not applied.

updates.summary: About Us || Responsive || Second hero banner size does not match Figma
updates.steps:
1. Open /world-of-sunny on mobile (≤390px).
2. Scroll to the Since 1997 section.
3. Inspect the second hero banner dimensions.
4. Compare with approved Figma mobile spec.
updates.expected: Second hero banner dimensions match Figma on mobile (SD-8).
updates.actual: Banner size on mobile does not match Figma — needs visual QA confirmation on QA environment.

updates.summary: World of Sunny || Mobile icon and text misaligned in Handcrafted section
updates.steps:
1. Open /world-of-sunny on mobile (≤390px).
2. Scroll to Handcrafted Brilliance text/utility tiles.
3. Inspect icon and text alignment on each tile.
updates.expected: Icon and text aligned per Figma on mobile (SD-133).
updates.actual: Text tiles use font-gill on mobile vs font-larken on md+ — icon/text alignment risk observed.

updates.summary: About Us || Handcrafted Brilliance || Divider does not match Figma
updates.steps:
1. Open /world-of-sunny on desktop and mobile.
2. Scroll to Handcrafted Brilliance.
3. Compare the divider below the section heading/text with Figma.
updates.expected: Divider styling matches Figma across breakpoints (SD-141).
updates.actual: Handcrafted divider differs: desktop uses border-b while mobile uses h-px span.
